description: This file declares a callback function for the CAN State Manager (CanSM) to handle bus-off events in an AUTOSAR-based automotive system. It includes licensing information, include guards, and a function prototype for `CanSM_ControllerBusOff`.

methods.name: CanSM_ControllerBusOff
methods.description: Callback function invoked when a CAN controller enters bus-off state; initiates recovery procedures.
